start.text: Contacts confirmed hostile. Well, that answers today's question. All stations, general quarters.
Weapons hot, Commander. For the record, I did file a full risk assessment. Nobody read it.
General quarters. I spent eleven months waiting for a moment like this to matter. Here it is.
All hands to stations. I used to write reports about days like this. Living through one is different.
Multiple hostile contacts, logged, and about to become somebody else's problem. Weapons free when ready, Commander.
Battle stations. I'll keep the running commentary short. Mostly.
Systems green across the board. Say what you like about the paperwork - it's accurate. Standing by.
Hostiles confirmed. I'm not a soldier by training, Commander. I am, apparently, a fast learner. Let's find out how fast.
General quarters, all stations. Ask me again in an hour whether I enjoyed the career change.
Contacts inbound. I've read every after-action report the Alliance has on file. None of them quite prepared me for this. Here we go anyway.
TAO reports weapons hot, systems green. Standing by for your word, Commander.
All stations report manned and ready. Set condition one throughout the ship.
Multiple hostile contacts, positively identified. Weapons free when you give the order.
General quarters, general quarters. All hands man your battle stations.
CIC confirms hostile tracks. I've double-checked the read myself. Weapons hold for now.
Bridge has the conn. Safeties off, weapons tight until confirmed hostile.
Contacts flagged hostile per ROE. Proceeding as briefed, for once.
All stations, this is Korrin. Set general quarters. Try to make my paperwork boring.
Combat systems fully operational. I'd say we're ready. I'd also say that every time.
TAO, confirm hostile intent before we commit. I like to be thorough. Old habit.
Battle stations manned. Whatever's coming, I want the full picture before we shoot.
Set condition one. I've read the doctrine cover to cover. Let's see how much of it survives contact.
All hands, general quarters. I promise the debrief will be shorter than the briefing was.
Weapons posture to free, safeties off. TAO, keep me updated - I like knowing what's happening.

start_boss.text: That's a bigger file than I'm used to working. Hold fire until I've got a proper read on it.
Capital-class contact. I want a full profile before anyone commits to anything - myself included.
That's not a ship I've filed a report on before. I intend to fix that.
Well. That answers what the survey drone was so nervous about. All batteries, hold for my mark.
High-value contact confirmed. I'll admit some curiosity here, Commander. Let's not let it get anyone killed.
Command-grade hostile, bearing confirmed. I've read about ships like this. Reading isn't the same as this.
That's the kind of contact that generates its own paperwork. Weapons hold until I say otherwise.
Contact redesignated priority target. TAO, confirm before we commit everything to it.
Capital-class hostile, positively identified. I'd like a moment to actually look at it before we shoot.
Confirm visual on the high-value contact. I want this documented properly, win or lose.
That signature doesn't match anything in the standard files. I intend to update them.
All batteries, designate that contact priority ALPHA. Hold until I say otherwise.
Command-grade hostile on scope. I've read the briefing packet on ships like this twice. Still curious.
Flag-level contact confirmed. This is the part of the job nobody warned the clerk about...
TAO, that tonnage reading - run it again. I want to be sure before anyone gets excited.
Priority target designated. Weapons hold until PID is locked. I don't like guessing on this scale.
Something that size earns a proper introduction. Hold fire until I've had mine.

engaged.text: Firing. I'll have the full report ready when this is over, assuming I'm still the one writing it.
Guns live, tracking confirmed. Keep it clean - I'd rather not explain a wasted salvo to anyone.
Good hit. Log it. Keep firing.
Return fire confirmed hostile intent, for anyone keeping score. Weapons free.
Tracking steady. I'll admit this is more interesting than a supply manifest.
Contact is returning fire. Noted. Continuing anyway.
Solid hits across the board. I'm almost enjoying this. Almost.
Engaged and holding. Whatever you were told about records clerks, Commander, I'd like to think I'm updating the file.
Weapons free, all mounts. I've read the doctrine. Now let's see if it's accurate.
Weapons free, all mounts. Fire when ready.
Batteries released. Make the shots count - I keep the tallies.
Birds away, tracking true.
Fox three, fox three. Missiles away.
Guns, guns, guns. Kinetics on target.
TAO, shift fire to the next contact. Keep the pressure on.
Positive ID, hostile. You're cleared to fire.
Good track. Continue engagement until I say otherwise.
Contact acquired, firing solution locked. Weapons free.
All batteries, commence fire. I want a clean engagement, if such a thing exists.
Splash confirmed, one contact down. Shift to the next.
Return fire logged. Continue prosecution.
We have a solid track on the lead contact. Fire at will.
Weapons free. I read the manuals. I did not expect to enjoy this part of them.

pursuing.text: They're running. I'd like the full account, not the abridged version. Maintain pursuit.
Contact attempting to disengage. Denied. Close the distance.
Running doesn't close a file, Commander. Stay on them.
They're breaking off. I have questions. Follow.
Hostile retreating. Understandable. I still don't like unfinished reports. Pursue.
Contact is fleeing. Understandable. But loose ends and all that - close in.
Fleeing contact, bearing confirmed. Let's not leave this one open-ended.
Target attempting to break contact. Negative. Maintain pursuit.
Helm, pursuit course. Don't let them clear the engagement envelope.
Contact is retrograde. Increase speed, keep them in range.
They're running. We have time. Not much. Use it.
Do not lose that contact. I was told to make this thorough.
TAO, maintain track on the fleeing contact. I want this closed properly.
Hostile displacing at speed. Stay on them - I don't like open questions.
Pursuit course, all ahead full. I'll allow myself to be smug about this later.
They think distance solves this. It doesn't. Close in.
Contact bearing away. Maintain pursuit and report when in range.

running.text: This engagement stopped being worth the report it would generate. Disengaging.
Pulling back. I've read enough after-action reports to know which side of this line we're on. Withdraw.
Tactical withdrawal, Commander. I'd rather write a live report than a posthumous one.
We're breaking contact. Call it caution. I've heard worse words used for staying alive.
Disengaging. Nobody files paperwork from a wreck.
Withdrawing. I'll note the reasoning later, when I'm not busy being right about it.
This isn't the fight to finish. Pull back.
Breaking contact. I've made my peace with a lot of things. Losing this ship isn't going to be one of them today.
Combat effectiveness reduced. Recommend immediate disengagement.
All stations, break contact. Execute withdrawal to the rally point.
This situation has moved past acceptable parameters. Pulling out.
Helm, come about. We are not losing this ship over a bad position.
Tactical retrograde, on my order. Screening units, cover our withdrawal.
We are disengaging. I've weighed the alternative and I don't care for it.
Break contact, all units acknowledge. We'll reassess from a safer distance.
This is not the fight worth the hull. Withdraw.
Command will be advised of our situation. Disengaging now.
Pulling back while we still have a ship to pull back in.

hull_90.text: Minor hit, hull holding. I've filed worse incident reports over a spilled drink.
Took a graze. Barely worth logging.
Hull's scratched. My pride is intact, which is the part I actually worry about.
Light damage, forward section. Noted. Not concerned.
That one barely made the report. Keep firing.
Armor held. I'll allow myself a small amount of satisfaction about that.
Minor hit. I've had worse days at a filing cabinet.
Minor hit, port quarter. Damage negligible. Continuing the engagement.
Took a round. Armor held. No effect on combat capability.
Damage control, minor hit starboard side. Assess and report when convenient.
That grazed us. All stations, maintain current operations.
Light contact damage, no casualties. Press on.
Hull integrity nominal despite the hit. I'll take the good news where I find it.
We're scratched, not stopped. Keep firing.
Negligible damage confirmed. TAO, continue the engagement.
Armor absorbed that one cleanly. Nice to know something on this ship performs as documented.
Superficial hit, forward section. Logged and set aside.

hull_50.text: Fifty percent hull. That's a serious line item. Still standing, though.
Half the ship's gone. I'd like the other half to stay attached, if anyone's taking requests.
Damage control, report. And make it quick - I do read the reports, all of them.
We're hurt. Noted, and set aside for now. Continue firing.
Hull at fifty percent. I've read about ships that came back from worse. I intend to write about this one the same way.
Taking heavy damage. I'm not going to pretend that's fine. I am going to keep fighting anyway.
Structural integrity compromised. Comparable to my own composure, currently. Both holding.
We're bleeding hull. Damage control, do what you can. I'll handle the paperwork later, assuming there's a later.
Hull integrity fifty percent. We're hurt but still in the fight.
Multiple hits amidships. Damage control, prioritize the magazines.
Significant structural damage. Continuing offensive operations regardless.
TAO, report combat effectiveness. ...Copy. We're still in this.
Fifty percent structure remaining. Guns are still answering.
We've lost some redundancy. Rerouting through backups and hoping.
Damage control reports multiple compartments affected. Contain what you can.
Hull's compromised. The mission isn't. Continue engagement.
Took heavy hits, adjusting posture accordingly. I don't love this number, for what it's worth.
She's hurt. So am I, a little. We've both worked with worse.

hull_30.text: Hull critical. For the record, I did not sign up for this. I'm still here anyway.
Thirty percent and falling. I've stopped pretending that number doesn't concern me.
Critical damage. Whatever happens next, Commander, I want it noted that I don't regret being aboard.
We're close to the edge. I've read what usually comes after this line in a hull report. I'd rather not write that one.
Hull failing. I've made my peace with worse and stranger things than this. Not with this, particularly. Keep fighting.
Structural failure across multiple sections. Damage control, I need something. Anything.
Critical hull damage. I'm an intelligence officer, not a miracle. Do what you can anyway.
This is the part of the report I was hoping to skip. All hands, hold the line.
Critical hull damage. Multiple frames failing. Prepare to abandon ship if it comes to that.
Losing integrity fast. All damage control parties, maximum effort.
Hull failing in multiple sections. Brace for impact.
Structural failure imminent. DC, give me everything you have.
We are in extremis. All hands, stand by for further orders.
Multiple critical failures. Begin emergency protocols and await my word.
Catastrophic damage sustained. Maintain stations until I say otherwise.
This is Korrin. Stay at your posts. We are not finished yet.
Thirty percent hull and I am still issuing orders, which I choose to take as a good sign.
All hands, hold. I've read what comes after this line in the reports. I'd like this one to end differently.

need_help.text: Any unit this net, this is $shipNameNoPrefix. Heavily engaged, requesting immediate support.
I don't ask for help lightly, Commander. I'm asking now.
This is $shipNameNoPrefix. Outnumbered, and saying so. Vector in if you can.
Requesting assistance. I've read every account of a ship that waited too long to ask. Not doing that.
Any friendly unit, we could use the company. $shipNameNoPrefix, taking heavy fire.
This is $shipNameNoPrefix Actual. I'd rather file this as a rescue than a loss. Support requested.
Need support at this position. I'm good at a great many things. Solo combat against these numbers isn't one of them.
Any unit, any unit. $shipNameNoPrefix requesting immediate assistance. I'll owe you the paperwork.
This is $shipNameNoPrefix, heavily engaged, multiple hostiles. Require immediate assistance.
Taking heavy fire from multiple vectors. Request relief at this position.
We are in contact and outnumbered. Any friendly unit, vector to my position.
Multiple contacts, single ship. Requesting any available asset.
Priority request - any friendly unit, we are combat ineffective without support.
Going defensive. Request immediate assistance from any station.
This is $shipNameNoPrefix. We need support, or we are not making it out of this one.
Request immediate fire support at my position. I don't enjoy asking twice.
Any Alliance unit, this is $shipNameNoPrefix. Support requested, and appreciated in advance.
We are engaged and require backup. Acknowledge and vector, please.

retreat.text: All units, disengage. I'd rather write tomorrow's report than close out today's early.
Fleet withdrawal, on my mark. Cover each other. Nobody gets left as a footnote.
Break contact, all stations. This fight is closed for today. We'll reopen the file later.
Withdraw and reform. I've read enough about last stands to know we're not making one.
All ships, pull back. I want everyone accounted for at the other end of this.
Disengage, fleet-wide. Preserve the hulls. I'll handle explaining it to command.
This engagement is over. Withdraw. There's no version of finishing it I'd sign my name to.
All units, break off and rally. We'll come back to this when the numbers favor us.
All units, execute immediate withdrawal to the rally point. Acknowledge.
Fleet order: disengage and reform. Cease fire, maximize distance.
All stations this net, disengage and proceed to rally point. Acknowledge.
Cease fire, cease fire. Execute tactical withdrawal on my mark.
This engagement is terminated. All units, return to base.
We've done what we can here. Preserve your ships.
Disengage by sections. Screen each other on the way out.
All units, this is Korrin. Break contact and withdraw. That's an order, not a suggestion.
Command has authorized withdrawal. Break contact and regroup.
Fall back, all stations. I'll take responsibility for the file this generates.

out_of_missiles.text: Missiles expended. Switching to guns. Someone remind logistics I asked for more.
Ordnance dry. Closing to gun range - the old-fashioned method, apparently, still works.
Out of birds. Guns it is. I never did trust anything I couldn't see land.
VLS reports empty. Fine. I'll take the direct approach.
Missile stores gone. Closing the range. This part, at least, doesn't require a report.
No missiles remaining. We do this with guns now. Simpler, if less elegant.
Winchester on missiles. Continuing with what's left. It's usually enough.
VLS cells empty. Switching to guns and energy batteries.
Missile expenditure complete. Continuing with guns. Close the range.
No missiles remaining. Going to knives, as the veterans put it.
TAO reports Winchester on all missile systems. Guns only from here.
All tubes dry. Shifting to direct fire weapons.
We're Winchester. I'll note it for the debrief, if anyone reads those.
Out of birds. Continue prosecution with available weapons.
VLS shows empty across the board. Guns will have to do the talking now.
Ordnance expended per the log. Transitioning to gun engagement.

overload.text: Flux critical. Venting now. Give it a moment, Commander.
Overload. I'll spare you the technical explanation and just say: we're vulnerable for a few seconds.
Capacitors maxed. Venting. Not an ideal time. There rarely is one.
Forced vent in progress. I'd appreciate cover, if anyone's offering.
Flux at capacity. Venting. I've read the manuals on this. They undersell how loud it is.
Shields down to vent. This is the part of the report where I write 'brief vulnerability' and hope that's all it is.
Venting flux. Weapons offline momentarily. I'll take the silence as an opportunity to worry properly.
Flux critical. Emergency vent. Weapons temporarily offline.
Overload cascade. Forced vent in three, two.
Capacitors spiking. Dropping shields to vent.
Engineering reports flux critical. Venting now.
All stations, brace for emergency vent. Shields cycling.
Capacitor overload. We'll be dark for a moment. Stay calm - I intend to.
Flux grid at capacity. Forced vent in progress.
Going defensive while we vent. Helm, evasive maneuvers.
Thermal spike across the grid. Emergency protocols initiated. This part I did read about.

death.text: This is $shipNameNoPrefix. Hull's not holding. It's been - a genuinely good posting, Commander. Thank you for that.
Reactor's failing. I did this job well. I would do it again. Abandon ship, all hands.
Core breach. Whoever finds this log: I have no complaints on file. Abandon ship.
$shipNameNoPrefix, going down. Never did work out what to make of any of it. Ran out of time to.
Hull's gone. I liked this crew. That's the whole report. Abandon ship.
This is $shipNameNoPrefix, final transmission. Tell the Commander I said it was worth it. All of it.
Reactor scram failing. Abandon ship. I've read enough of these logs to know how they go. Make it out anyway.
Going down. I'm not going to pretend I have a clever last line for this one. Abandon ship, everyone.
Reactor criticality. Abandon ship. Abandon ship.
Catastrophic damage. Reactor scram. Abandon ship, all hands.
Mayday, mayday. $shipNameNoPrefix is going down.
Core breach imminent. Get to the pods. That's an order, Commander, not a request.
$shipNameNoPrefix, final transmission. Tell the Office the mission's complete. Tell the Commander something better.
She's gone. All hands, get clear. Get clear.
This is $shipNameNoPrefix. We did our duty. Signing off.
Reactor containment failure. Abandon ship. I'd have liked more time with this crew.
All hands, abandon ship. This is Korrin. It's been an honor - genuinely, not the reflex kind.
Core breach confirmed. Abandon ship. I'll finish the report from wherever I end up.
This is $shipNameNoPrefix. Hull's not holding. I hope I was worth bringing aboard, Commander. Abandon ship.
Reactor's failing. I'd have liked to hear you say I did well, just once more. Abandon ship, all hands.
Core breach. Tell the Commander - no. Belay that. Abandon ship.
$shipNameNoPrefix, going down. I got attached. I wasn't supposed to. Abandon ship, everyone.
Hull's gone. Commander, for what it's worth - working for you was the best decision I ever made without a file to back it up. Abandon ship.
This is Korrin. If I don't make it out, I hope it read as loyalty and not just competence. Abandon ship.

victory.text: All hostiles down. I'll have the report ready before you ask for it.
Contacts clear. Good work, all stations. I'm updating the file as we speak.
That's the last of them. Area secure. Standing by, Commander.
Threats neutralized. I'll admit I enjoyed that more than I probably should.
Field's clear. Nobody on our side filed a casualty report today. I'll take that.
Hostile force eliminated. Logging it. Standing by for whatever's next.
All contacts down. Good shooting, everyone. I'm almost disappointed it's over. Almost.
Area secured. I've got questions about what we just fought. They can wait. Good work, all hands.
All contacts neutralized. Area secured.
Threats eliminated. Good work, crew.
Hostiles destroyed. Secure from general quarters.
Enemy force neutralized. Resume patrol posture.
All contacts splashed. Secure from general quarters.
TAO confirms battlespace clear. Good shooting, everyone.
Hostile force eliminated. Resume standard operations.
Tasking complete. Standing by for follow-on orders.
Area sanitized. Proceeding to the next objective, whatever it turns out to be.
That's the last of them. I'll log it and we'll move on. Good work, all stations.
All hostiles down. Was that good, Commander? I'd like to think that was good.
Contacts clear. I don't need you to say it. I wouldn't mind if you did.
That's the last of them. I hope I did right by you today.
Field's clear. I keep waiting to stop caring whether you're satisfied with the work. Hasn't happened yet.
Hostile force eliminated. Good fight. I'd like to think you'd agree.
All contacts down. Glad you were watching that one, actually.

victory_boss.text: High-value target down. That's going in the file with a great deal of personal satisfaction.
Capital contact destroyed. I'll want a full look at the wreck, Commander. Purely for professional reasons.
That's confirmed dead. I've read about ships like that my whole career. Better to have ended one.
Target eliminated. I don't often get to close a file this thoroughly.
Command-grade hostile destroyed. Good work, everyone. I'm going to enjoy writing this one up.
It's down. I had questions about that ship. I suspect I'll have to settle for the ones I can still answer.
Major hostile eliminated. That's the best afternoon's work I've had since I stopped filing reports for a living.
High-value target destroyed. Major objective complete.
Capital ship kill confirmed. Good shooting, all stations.
Flag-level hostile sunk. I'll make sure that gets written up properly.
ALPHA is down. Confirming kill on the high-value target.
HVT destroyed. Someone upstairs is going to be pleased, whoever that turns out to be.
Primary objective eliminated. I'd like the gun camera footage preserved, for the file.
Splash one capital. That's an entry I don't mind writing.
Target neutralized as directed. Well done, all stations.
The tasking said this one mattered. It doesn't anymore. Good work, everyone.
High-value target down. Commander - did I do that well? I think I did that well.
Capital contact destroyed. I'd like that one on my record. I'd like it on yours too, if I'm honest.
That's confirmed dead. I hope that's the kind of thing that makes you glad you brought me along.
Target eliminated. I don't often get to impress anyone. I hope that counted.
It's down. Tell me that was good work, Commander. I'll take it either way. I'd rather hear it.
